pages.text: The dose hint accounts for the patient's weight. Half a dose — weaker and shorter; one and a half — stronger, but closer to overdose.

Overdose: opioids — respiratory arrest, diazepam — deep sleep and depressed breathing, paracetamol — the liver, NSAIDs — bleeding, norepinephrine — racing pulse and pressure.$(br2)Naloxone reverses opioids at once.
